supportAccess.title: Support access
supportAccess.lede: bleqq support can read your organisation only when one of you lets them in, only for the time you allow, and never change anything. Every page they open is in your audit log.
supportAccess.pending.title: Waiting for your decision
supportAccess.active.title: Access now
supportAccess.history.title: History
supportAccess.history.caption: Every grant stays here. Each page a support session opened is a support access read in the audit log, with the address it opened and who opened it.
supportAccess.history.auditLog: See the reads in the audit log
supportAccess.emptyTitle: Nobody from bleqq has asked for access
supportAccess.emptyBody: When someone does, the members who manage security are emailed and the request waits here.
supportAccess.hoursFromApproval: {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, starting when you approve
supportAccess.approveHint: Approving asks for your passkey. They can read, never change, and cannot search, ask or download files.
supportAccess.revokeHint: Revoking ends it at once. Their next page opens nothing.
supportAccess.needsSecurity: Only a member who manages security can approve, decline or revoke.
supportAccess.stepUpCancelled: Nothing changed. Approving needs your passkey.
supportAccess.stale: This request was already decided or has lapsed. The list now shows where it stands.
supportAccess.banner.title: Support access to {tenant}.
supportAccess.ended.title: Support access has ended
supportAccess.ended.body: {tenant} revoked the access, or its window closed. Nothing more can be read.
supportAccess.problem.readOnly: A support session can only read. Nothing was changed.
supportAccess.problem.ended: Support access has ended. Nothing more can be read.
